_doc: Curated technique seeds (knowledge_architecture.md section 5), one file per area. Fields: id, level + scope (a scope node or universal), aliases (v1 / technique-DB / footer names folded in), mechanism, preconditions (predicate DSL), predicts (canonical metric -> up|down|flat|up_or_flat|down_or_flat), risks (pitfalls), states / op_classes / op_kinds gates (empty = any), slot (offered by the multi-slot agent), prior {mean, n}: a seed prior with a low pseudo-count that evidence overrides, realizations by scope (target:<key> | target:<backend>:sm_NN+ | target:<backend> | node:<id> | universal). Loaded by Ontology.seed(); scripts/seed_knowledge.py builds a knowledge.db from these files.

techniques.mechanism: VLEN-agnostic strip-mining with vsetvli, choosing LMUL so the loop moves VLEN*LMUL bits per instruction without spilling vector registers
risks: LMUL=m8 leaves 4 register groups: spills in kernels with many live vectors

realizations.how: for (; n > 0; n -= vl) { vl = __riscv_vsetvl_e32m4(n); ... } with LMUL m4/m8 for streaming loops, m1/m2 for kernels with many live vectors.

techniques.mechanism: segment loads de-interleave AoS / channel-interleaved data into separate vector registers in one instruction

realizations.how: __riscv_vlseg2e32_v_f32m2x2 / vlseg3 / vlseg4 for interleaved fields (complex, RGB, NHWC channel groups); vsseg to store back.

techniques.mechanism: widening multiply-accumulate keeps fp16 / int8 products in wider accumulators without separate converts

realizations.how: vfwmacc.vv (fp16 -> fp32) / vwmacc.vv (int8 -> int16) in the inner product; narrow once at the end.

techniques.mechanism: in-register vector reductions (vfredusum / vfredmax) over independent partial vectors instead of a scalar loop
risks: vfredusum is unordered: differs from a sequential sum in the last bits; vfredosum is ordered but slow

realizations.how: Accumulate element-wise into a vector partial (vfadd.vv) across the strip-mined loop, one vfredusum.vs at the end.
